description: This is a Java configuration class for setting up email services within a Spring Boot project. It configures properties for JavaMailSender, Thymeleaf templates, and message sources used for email functionality.

classes.name: EmailConfiguration
classes.description: Spring configuration class for email setup, including JavaMailSender and Thymeleaf template resolver.

methods.name: getJavaMailSender
methods.description: Creates and configures a JavaMailSender bean with SMTP properties.

methods.name: thymeleafTemplateEngine
methods.description: Sets up the Thymeleaf template engine with a specified template resolver and message source.

methods.name: thymeleafClassLoaderTemplateResolver
methods.description: Defines the template resolver looking for HTML templates in the classpath, with a configurable path prefix.

methods.name: emailMessageSource
methods.description: Creates a resource bundle message source for email message localization.
